page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; running head "Admonitio." centred above the text; a signature mark "A *4" at the foot below the last line, left of centre; a catchword-like mark below it. No margin notes. Digitiser's watermark at lower right is excluded.

main_text.p: tibus Regum, quod Papa fit Antichristus eos exolveret à consilio perstandi in Communione capitis Ecclesiæ, utut morbidi & ulceribus obsiti, imo Antichristi: quin potius in propositio firmaret non discedendi ab Ecclesia Romana, quandiu ei insider Antichristus: nam hoc potissimum argumento permoti Petrus Martyr in Italia per decennium, Paulus Sarpius tota vitâ Venetiis, permanserunt in Ecclesia Romana, licet inter hæc firmiter crederent, nec dissimularent inter amicos & fidos, Papam esse Antichristum. At ne horam unam in obsequio Papæ permaneret Rex, cui semel compertum esset, (idque sanè unius horæ spatio & reputatione intelligeret) Papam sub tectorio & fuco potestatis Ecclesiasticæ, & spi-

page.notes: The first line "tibus Regum" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Running head is "Admonitio." with a stray mark after it. The text "fit Antichristus" and "insider" as printed: "insidet" is printed "insidet" in the scan and reads "insidet"; the scan shows "insider" which I could not confirm, so it may be a misreading. The final line ends with "&spi-" hyphenated across the page. Signature "A *4" is partly obscured; the symbol after A is a star, and the last mark is a fleuron-like symbol, transcribed as best possible.
